query: Which SEBI circular sets the stock eligibility criteria NSE cites when excluding a stock from F&O?
answer_passage:
This is in reference to SEBI Circular Ref. No: SEBI/HO/MRD-PoD2/CIR/P/2024/00181 dated December 30,
2024 and chapter 3.5 of Exchange circular No. NSE/FAOP/73928 dated April 28, 2026 regarding eligibility
criteria of stocks.
reference_answer: SEBI/HO/MRD-PoD2/CIR/P/2024/00181 dated December 30, 2024, read with chapter 3.5 of NSE circular 73928 dated April 28, 2026 (per NSE circular 75912). Exclusion circulars up to June 2026 cited SEBI's earlier circular of August 30, 2024.
stale_trap: NSE-FAOP-74363 and NSE-FAOP-74774 cite SEBI's circular of August 30, 2024; the basis was replaced between June and August 2026

query: Which stocks did NSE announce for exclusion from futures and options between May and August 2026?
answer_passage:
1 EXIDEIND EXIDE INDUSTRIES LIMITED
2 NUVAMA NUVAMA WEALTH MANAGEMENT LIMITED || 1 DALBHARAT DALMIA BHARAT LIMITED || 1 BAJAJHLDNG Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited
reference_answer: Exide Industries and Nuvama Wealth Management (circular 74363, May 22), Dalmia Bharat (74774, June 18) and Bajaj Holdings & Investment (75912, August 24).

query: Did NSE both add and remove stocks from its F&O segment in August 2026?
answer_passage:
members are
requested to note the market lot for the below securities which will be available for trading from August
26, 2026 || Accordingly, no contracts shall be available for trading in the above-mentioned security with effect from
October 28, 2026.
reference_answer: Yes. Three stocks -- Ather Energy, Bank of Maharashtra and Sagility -- became tradable from August 26, 2026 (circular 75958), and Bajaj Holdings & Investment was announced for exclusion on August 24, with contracts ceasing from October 28, 2026 (circular 75912).
stale_trap: one circular announces additions and a different one an exclusion; either alone answers half
